literal: With wife subordinated nature's lack always among good people shame will give.
translation: The unnatural state of being subordinated to one's wife will always bring shame among good people.
modern: மனைவியிடம் தாழ்ந்து நடக்கும் இயல்பற்ற நிலை ஒருவனுக்கு நல்லவர்களிடையே எப்போதும் வெட்கத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the social consequences of a man being overly submissive to his wife. The phrase இல்லாள்கண் தாழ்ந்த describes the act of being subordinated to one's spouse. The word இன்மை means absence or lack, and here combined with இயல்பு (nature) it means a lack of proper nature or unnatural conduct. The word நல்லார் can sometimes mean women, but here it takes the sense of good and wise people. Because of his undignified behavior, such a man will always face shame when among the good.
